title: FBI-UAP-D023, Digital Rendering, Narrative Statement 2-7, Western United States Event, 2023
doc_notes: This document is a digital rendering created by the FBI in 2026 based on a first-hand account of a UAP sighting in October 2023.

incidents.summary: Five glowing red lights in an upward-curving arc observed over a mountain range near a sensitive national security site.
incidents.quote: five glowing red lights are arranged in a shallow, upward-curving arc against the dark night sky
